what: porting tests to a root heap made at the test's top meets types with no lifetime that hold tables over Alloc<'static> (Built, RunError::Trapped's strings, proc-macro Runtime): a borrowed root cannot reach them, so each such test either waits for the type to take a lifetime or uses Root::leak
cost: most of the lane's reading: finding which 'static demands are a type's missing lifetime and which are only a signature's
cause: the ambient heap made 'static handles free, so types were written without an allocator lifetime
whys: Heap::process() and testing::heap() returned &'static; nothing made a type state how long its allocator lives
class: a type holding allocator-backed values with no lifetime parameter
prevention: Root::leak is counted in its own ratchet column (tools/ratchets/alloc-global.txt `leak`), test code included, so each 'static demand shows and falls
annoyance: Grep and Glob were missing in this lane's session; read-only grep through Bash stood in
